name: Celine
why: Sharp Parisian tailoring and casual clothing with a youth-culture edge.
origin: Founded in Paris in 1945 by Céline Vipiana as a children's shoe shop.

notes.fren: Paris, and the silhouette is French minimalism read through youth culture — narrow, sharp, and deliberately unornamented.
notes.status: Quiet-luxury status — nothing on the outside, but the silhouette reads instantly to anyone who already knows. It signals to a specific room rather than to the street.

notes.craft: Celine owns two leather goods workshops in Tuscany, at Strada in Chianti (acquired 1994) and Radda in Chianti (opened 2019), run as Celine Production. Leather goods are more than half of sales. Nothing shows owned making for ready-to-wear, so this is owned making for a core category, not the range: a 4 if leather-goods-only owned making is allowed to lift a clothing score, otherwise it stays at 3.

cities: 19 stores, including Las Vegas, New York, Atlanta · department stores, and its own site

craft_evidence.owned_d: LEATHER GOODS ONLY, owned by Celine (LVMH house), not by LVMH group directly. Two Tuscan workshops per FashionNetwork and Carnets du Luxe (both 18 Oct 2019, reporting the inauguration): Strada in Chianti (production from 1979, acquired by Celine 1994, ~300 staff, leather goods prototyping, production and repairs, training centre) and 'La Manufacture', Radda in Chianti (opened 2019, 5,200 m2, 129 staff at opening, handbags and SLGs incl. Trio, Triomphe). Architizer names the operating company 'CELINE Production', which handles 'production and prototyping of leather goods'. No owned ready-to-wear or footwear facility found. Not seen on celine.com (not fetched).
